items.label: Cloud-like Material
items.value: The queen comforter set is made of premium material, whether the comforter, bed sheet, or pillowcase, we all opt for upgraded premium microfiber, which is as soft as a cloud with no static electricity troubles or concerns

items.label: Luxuriously Soft Fabric
items.value: Crafted from brushed microfiber, the HEVUMYI queen bedding set delivers unparalleled softness. Its smooth, breathable texture ensures ultimate comfort while remaining whisper-quiet, allowing for a restful night's sleep

items.label: Practical Details
items.value: The 360° elastic fitted sheet with a deep pocket fits most mattresses about 10"-14" deep. The baffle box construction of the comforter prevents the fiber fill from shifting, even after several times of wash

items.label: 7-Piece Queen Bed in a Bag Set
items.value: The HEVUMYI queen-size comforter set includes 7 pieces: 1 all-season comforter (88" x 88"), 2 pillowcases (20" x 30"), 2 pillow shams (20" x 26" + 2"), 1 flat sheet (90" x 102"), and 1 fitted sheet (60" x 80" + 14" deep)

items.label: Easy Care Tips
items.value: All comforter sets are transported in exclusive cartons. Please machine wash in a gentle cycle with mild detergent, use dryer balls in the dryer to help distribute filling evenly. Remember to use a cool iron to help remove wrinkles

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 Comforter (88" x 88"), 1 Fitted Sheet (60" x 80" + 14" deep), 1 Flat Sheet (90" x 102"), 2 Pillowcases (20" x 30"), 2 Pillow Shams (20" x 26" + 2" edge)
